extracted.intended_audience: authors and reportors of systematic reviews and meta-analyses; journal editors and peer reviewers of such reports
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and checklists for how to report systematic reviews and meta-analyses (PRISMA 2020), including the main checklist, flow diagrams, abstract checklist, and multiple specialised extensions. Intended to be applied to the whole systematic review report to improve completeness and transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: Reporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Reporting systematic reviews and meta-analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA 2020 is the reporting guideline provided for systematic reviews and meta-analyses. The statement, checklist, expanded checklist, and flow diagrams are available from the PRISMA website and in multiple formats (Word, PDF, Shiny App).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA 2020 checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA 2020 checklist (Word/PDF).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the PRISMA 2020 checklist to ensure each required reporting item for a systematic review/meta-analysis is addressed. An expanded checklist and an online/shiny app version are available to assist completion.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
rubrics_metrics.description: All versions (including a Shiny App) of the PRISMA 2020 flow diagram are available (for both new and updated systematic reviews).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the flow diagram to transparently report the study identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion process; choose the appropriate diagram for new vs updated reviews and use the downloadable/interactive versions as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts (abstract checklist)
rubrics_metrics.description: The PRISMA 2020 for Abstracts reporting guideline is contained within the main PRISMA 2020 Statement paper.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the abstract checklist items when preparing the structured abstract for a systematic review; translations of the abstract checklist are available in multiple languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply PRISMA to the whole report
rubrics_metrics.description: Applies to the whole report.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA 2020 items are intended to guide reporting across the entire systematic review report (not only parts such as the abstract or methods). Authors should consult the checklist for items covering title, abstract, introduction, methods, results, discussion, and other information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use PRISMA translations where appropriate
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA 2020 Statement and checklists are available in multiple languages (e.g., Italian, Croatian, Greek, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish; checklists in many other languages).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When authors or journals operate in other languages, use the official translations of the PRISMA statement/checklists/flow diagrams to ensure fidelity to the guideline; links to translations are provided on the PRISMA website.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-Equity (extension)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-Equity: PRISMA-Equity 2012 Extension: Reporting Guidelines for Systematic Reviews with a Focus on Health Equity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-Equity when the review specifically addresses health equity concerns to ensure equity-relevant reporting items are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-P (protocols)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-P: Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis Protocols (PRISMA-P) 2015 statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-P when developing and reporting a systematic review protocol to ensure complete protocol reporting prior to conduct of the review.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-IPD (individual participant data)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-IPD: Preferred reporting items for systematic review and meta-analyses of individual participant data: the PRISMA-IPD Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-IPD when the review synthesises individual participant data to report IPD-specific items (data collection, harmonisation, participant-level analyses).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA extension for network meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA Extension Statement for Reporting of Systematic Reviews Incorporating Network Meta-analyses of Health Care Interventions: Checklist and Explanations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When conducting network meta-analyses, apply this extension to report network-specific methods, assumptions, and results (e.g., geometry of network, inconsistency, transitivity).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-harms (harms reporting)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-harms: PRISMA harms checklist: improving harms reporting in systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-harms to ensure comprehensive reporting of adverse events/harms in systematic reviews of interventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-CI (complex interventions)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-CI: PRISMA-CI Extension Statement & Checklist (AHRQ Series on Complex Intervention Systematic Reviews - Paper 6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply PRISMA-CI for systematic reviews of complex interventions to capture complexity-related reporting elements (e.g., context, intervention components, adaptability).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-DTA (diagnostic test accuracy)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-DTA: Preferred Reporting Items for a Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Diagnostic Test Accuracy Studies: The PRISMA-DTA Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-DTA when reviewing diagnostic/prognostic test accuracy studies to report DTA-specific elements (index test, reference standard, accuracy measures).

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-ScR (scoping reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-ScR: PRISMA Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR): Checklist and Explanation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For scoping reviews, apply PRISMA-ScR to ensure appropriate reporting of scoping-specific objectives, eligibility, charting methods, and results.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-A (acupuncture)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-A: Reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analyses of acupuncture: the PRISMA for acupuncture checklist.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this extension when the review focuses on acupuncture (or similar traditional interventions) to report intervention-specific details.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-DTA for Abstracts
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-DTA for Abstracts: checklist, explanation, and elaboration for abstracts of diagnostic test accuracy systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply the DTA abstract checklist when preparing abstracts for DTA systematic reviews to ensure key diagnostic accuracy information is reported concisely.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-CHM (Chinese herbal medicines)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-CHM: PRISMA Extension for Chinese Herbal Medicines 2020 (PRISMA-CHM 2020).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this extension for systematic reviews of Chinese herbal medicines to capture CHM-specific reporting items.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-M 2020 (moxibustion)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-M 2020: PRISMA extension for moxibustion 2020: recommendations, explanation, and elaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply PRISMA-M when the review is specifically about moxibustion to ensure intervention-specific reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-S (reporting literature searches)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-S: an extension to the PRISMA Statement for Reporting Literature Searches in Systematic Reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-S to comprehensively report search methods (databases, search strategies, dates, filters, supplementary searches) to enhance reproducibility of the search.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-COSMIN for OMIs (outcome measurement instruments)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-COSMIN for OMIs: Guideline for reporting systematic reviews of outcome measurement instruments (OMIs).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Apply this guideline when reviewing outcome measurement instruments to ensure reporting of measurement properties, instrument selection, and synthesis methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA-LSR (living systematic reviews)
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA-LSR: Extension of the PRISMA 2020 statement for living systematic reviews (PRISMA-LSR): checklist and explanation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use PRISMA-LSR for living systematic reviews to report items relevant to continuous updating (search frequency, updating methods, versioning).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use linked Explanation & Elaboration documents
rubrics_metrics.description: PRISMA 2020 explanation and elaboration: updated guidance and exemplars for reporting systematic reviews (BMJ 2021;372:n160).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Explanation & Elaboration paper for detailed guidance, examples, and rationale behind each PRISMA item to inform how to implement items in reports.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use appropriate reporting guideline for protocols and related documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for developing protocols for systematic reviews and meta-analyses is provided in the PRISMA-P Statement.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When preparing protocols, follow PRISMA-P; authors should link protocol reporting to the eventual review reporting via PRISMA 2020 to ensure transparency across stages.
